purpose: Infrastructure smoke validation only; outputs are excluded from headline RelativeBench estimates.

weight_transformation.source: Each catalog-pinned Hugging Face revision is converted locally.
weight_transformation.provenance_requirement: Every converted file is SHA-256 hashed and tied to the source repository and revision.

execution.cache_policy: Use an isolated cache; source downloads may be removed after derived-file verification.

limitations: Four-bit outputs validate infrastructure and directional plausibility only.
Quantized outputs must never be pooled with full-precision primary estimates.
The 16 GB host cannot safely execute the selected BF16 checkpoints directly.
